method: OpenFOAM v2512 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, 180 L/min inlet, 1,200 iterations; fieldAverage of U and p over iterations 700-1200 (written with cfd_cpap_r41.py case --average-from 700). Outlet flows from cut sections; delivery from 600 flux-weighted streamlines per outlet in the mean field: the share passing within 1 mm of the print surface inside 10 (or 5) mm of the nozzle axis, and the share leaving upward past the hotend (Z > -70 mm). Values at each design's own estimated WS7040 operating point with a 1 m hose (flow exponent 1.983).
limitations: Airflow only: no temperature, heat transfer or printed result. Streamlines in a mean field show transport, not residence. The visors, the lip trim and the aim variants (vanes, louver, roof ramp) are CFD screening prototypes, not qualified or printed parts. Streamlines start at the outlet sections, so air that a trimmed floor releases before them is reported only as the nozzle_focus side_spill_lpm flux.

snapshot_repeatability.note: The same geometry and settings meshed and solved twice; snappyHexMesh in parallel is not bit-reproducible. Single iteration-1200 snapshots of the near-print sectors differ by up to this much, which is why this round uses iteration means.

hotend_clearance_limits.rule: Hard limit: no P22 material nearer any Bambu hotend part than the released P22, mounted and along the 60 mm -Y withdrawal (1 mm steps), and nothing added inside the hotend slot (|X| < 10.2 mm). Exact BREP distances.
